verdict.rationale: An identity and access management product with an admin console could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, for example anomaly or security suggestions, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI-generated insights or suggestions in Keycloak. The metrics guide's 'gain insights' wording refers to operational telemetry, not AI, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
